title: The Cart That Charges the Wrong Amount
description: Customers report duplicate promos, cent-level tax errors, lost quantities, inconsistent shipping, and carts leaking between sessions.
objective: Reproduce the reported failures and repair the implementation without changing its public interfaces.
expectedBehavior: Cart.add_item accumulates positive integer quantities; negative prices and invalid quantities raise ValueError. remove_item raises ValueError for missing SKUs, nonpositive quantities, or over-removal without mutation. Coupon codes SAVE10 (10%), SAVE20 (20%), and FIVE ($5) are validated and deduplicated. Apply percent coupons in code order before fixed discounts, rounding each percent step half-up to cents; clamp the discounted subtotal to zero. Tax is 8.25% of the discounted subtotal, rounded half-up per order. Shipping is free at a discounted subtotal >= $50; otherwise $5.99. Empty carts cost zero. Sessions and constructor inputs must not share mutable cart state. subtotal and total return numeric dollar amounts.
constraints: Use only the language standard library; no network access or external packages.
The provided tests are read-only; additional private tests verify edge cases.
